title: Topspin Drive Mechanics (Michelle Grogan)
style: progressive trance 134bpm female whisper vocal tribal drums djembe congas taiko horns brass stabs animal calls bird whoop wolf howl ambient pads English Spanish coach calls
lyrics:
[Whisper intro]
Drive with spin not flat
Dip the ball at their feet
Low to high swing path
Brush up the ball back

[Whisper verse]
Feet step into the ball
Knees bend low and load
Paddle below the ball start
Grip pressure five out of ten

Contact in front of the body
Waist height window
Low to high steep angle
Face closed slightly down

[Tribal drop chant]
Topspin drive topspin drive
Dip and dive dip and dive
Vamos firme pa lante
Topspin drive topspin drive

[Whisper verse]
Landing zone the kitchen line
Spin pulls the ball down fast
Medium pace heavy spin
Low bounce off the court

Follow through up to the shoulder
Return to ready balanced
Reset feet shoulder width
Breath out and ready paddle

[Tribal drop chant]
Topspin drive topspin drive
Dip and dive dip and dive
Vamos firme pa lante
Topspin drive topspin drive

[Whisper outro]
Brush up
Spin and dip
Brush up
Spin and dip
